_readme: This repo's required checks (marvin#826). GitHub CI runs each one as a job with this exact name, MARVIN's merge gate runs the same ones through .github/run-check.sh (its project profile folds this list in), and branch protection on main requires these names. A check with "paths" runs only when a PR touches one (globs, * crosses /); on main, after a merge, every check runs. Format: lib/required_checks.py in G-Eskayo/marvin. Drift test: node --test scripts/required-checks.test.mjs

checks.name: App builds (iOS Simulator)
command: D=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/clarity-derived.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT; xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project CaptionSpike.xcodeproj -scheme CaptionSpike -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath "$D" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

checks.name: Mac app builds (macOS)
command: D=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/clarity-mac-derived.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT; M=Resources/Models/Sortformer_v2.1.mlmodelc; if [ ! -d "$M" ]; then sh ../../scripts/fetch-diarizer-models.sh && mkdir -p Resources/Models && cp -cR ../Spike/Resources/Models/Sortformer_v2.1.mlmodelc Resources/Models/; fi; xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project CaptionMac.xcodeproj -scheme CaptionMac -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath "$D" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

checks.name: Website checks (site/)
command: node --test scripts/build-site.test.mjs scripts/lang-offer.test.mjs scripts/required-checks.test.mjs && node scripts/build-site.mjs --check && node scripts/check-site.mjs && node --test scripts/check-evidence.test.mjs && node scripts/check-evidence.mjs
